## Setup
```{r init, message = FALSE}
library("GimmmeMySC")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("Seurat")
library("rlist")
library("cowplot")

path <- file.path(
  dirname(getwd()),
  "inst",
  "extdata"
)

source(file.path(path, "conf.R"))

split.by = 'Type'
cell_label <- "cell_type_formatted"

path_fig <- file.path(dirname(getwd()), "vignettes", "figures", "get_started")
```

## Load data
```{r data, eval = FALSE}
seurat <- readRDS(file.path(path, "all_cell_ko.rds"))
seurat$cell_type_formatted <- remove_parenthesis(seurat$cell_subtype)
seurat$cell_subtype_formatted <- keep_parenthesis(seurat$cell_subtype)

seurat@assays$SCT@scale.data <- matrix()

seurat <- NormalizeData(seurat) %>%
    FindVariableFeatures() %>%
    ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA(
    reduction_key = "Dim. ",
  npcs = max_dim
)
```

```{r}
load(file.path(path, "type_integrated.rda"))
```

## PCA
### Dimension selection
```{r}
eig <- seurat[['pca']]@stdev / sum(seurat[['pca']]@stdev) * 100
plot_pca_qc(eig)

cumsum(eig) %>% .[n_dim] %>% round(1)
cumsum(eig) %>% .[. < 80] %>% last() %>% round(1)
```

```{r, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 12}
list.map(
  list(seq(15), 16:30, 31:45),
  ~DimHeatmap(seurat, dims = ., cells = 500, balanced = TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
comp_genes <- list.map(
    seq(max_dim),
    f(x) ~ Loadings(seurat, reduction = "pca") %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        select(paste0("PC_", x)) %>%
        arrange(abs(!!sym(paste0("PC_", x)))) %>%
        tail(20) %>%
        rownames()
) %>% set_names(seq(max_dim))

list.map(
  lapply(cc.genes, func_format),
  f(i) ~lapply(comp_genes, function(x) x[x %in% func_format(i)]) %>% compact()
) %>% set_names(c("G2/M", "S"))
```

### Component markers
```{r pca_plot}
# Markers
print(seurat[['pca']], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
VizDimLoadings(seurat, dims = 1:2, reduction = 'pca')
```


```{r}
plot_dim(
```

## Integration
```{r}
if (is.null(seurat[["RNA"]]@layers$data.1)) {
  seurat[["RNA"]] <- split(
      seurat[["RNA"]],
      f = seurat[[]][, split.by],
      layers = c("counts", "data")
  )
}
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(seurat) <- "RNA"
integration_method <- "RPCA"
seurat <- IntegrateLayers(
    object = seurat, 
    method = get(paste0(integration_method, "Integration")),
    new.reduction = integration_method,
    # reduction.key = "Dim. ",
    orig.reduction = "pca",
    dims.to.integrate = seq(n_dim),
    normalization.method = ifelse(SCT, "SCT", "LogNormalize"),
    verbose = TRUE
)

seurat[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seurat[["RNA"]])

Idents(seurat) <- split.by
```

## UMAP
```{r}
seurat <- RunUMAP(
  seurat, 
  dims = seq(n_dim),
  reduction = integration_method
)
```

```{r}
plot_dim(
```

## Annotation
### Main cell types
```{r}
Idents(seurat) <- cell_label
plot_bar_sc(seurat)

Idents(seurat) %>% 
    cluster_size() %>% 
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_cells.png"))

plot_dim(seurat)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    group.by = cell_label,
    split.by = cell_label,
    ncol = 3,
    label = FALSE
) + NoLegend()
```

### B cells
```{r, message = FALSE}
b_cell <- subset(seurat, cell_type_formatted == "B cell")
Idents(b_cell) <- "cell_subtype_formatted"

plot_dim(b_cell) + labs(title = "B cell", x = NULL)
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_dim(
    b_cell,
    split.by = "cell_subtype_formatted",
    label = FALSE,
    ncol = 3
) +
    NoLegend()
```

### Cell subtypes
```{r}
Idents(seurat) <- "cell_subtype_formatted"
plot_bar_sc(seurat)

Idents(seurat) %>% 
    cluster_size() %>% 
    kable_sc(file = file.path(path_fig, "table_subcells.png"))

plot_dim(seurat)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
Idents(seurat) <- "cell_subtype_formatted"
plot_dim(
    seurat,
    cols = palette_continuous(gray = FALSE)(unique(seurat$cell_subtype_formatted) %>% length())
)

cell_categories <- seurat$cell_type_formatted %>% unique() %>% na.omit()

list.map(
    cell_categories,
    f(x, y) ~ subset(seurat, cell_type_formatted == x)
    ) %>%
list.map(
    f(x, y, z) ~
        plot_dim(
            x,
            group.by = "cell_subtype_formatted",
            cols = rep(palette_discrete(), 5),
            pt.size = .25
        ) +
        labs(title = z, x = NULL) 
) %>% plot_grid(plotlist = ., align = "hv", nrow = 2)

cell_list <- map(cell_categories, ~ {
  seurat$cell_subtype[str_detect(seurat$cell_subtype, paste0("^", .x))] %>% na.omit() %>% keep_parenthesis()
}) %>%
  set_names(cell_categories)

p <- list.map(
  compact(cell_list),
  f(x, y, z) ~ plot_bar_sc(x, z)
)

plot_grid(plotlist = p, align = "hv", ncol = 3, nrow = 2)
```

## Clustering
```{r clus_int}
resolution2 <- seq(.1, .4, 0.05)
resolution <- c(seq(.5, 1, by = 0.1), 1.2, 1.5)
resolution_tot <- c(resolution2, resolution)
seurat <- FindNeighbors(
  seurat,
  reduction = integration_method, 
  dims = seq(n_dim)
)

seurat <- FindClusters(
  seurat,
  verbose = FALSE,
  algorithm = 3,
  resolution = resolution_tot,
  graph.name = tail(names(seurat@graphs), 1)
)

seurat2 <- seurat
prefix_cl <- paste0(assay, "_snn_res.")
cols_to_remove <- paste0(prefix_cl, resolution[-1])
seurat2@meta.data <- seurat2@meta.data[, !colnames(seurat2@meta.data) %in% cols_to_remove]

select(seurat@meta.data, contains(prefix_cl)) %>%
     list.mapv(f(x) ~ levels(x) %>% length()) %>% 
    set_names(names(.) %>% str_remove(prefix_cl)) %>%
  plot_bar_sc0(label_y = "value", sort = "desc")
```

```{r}
clusters <- grep(prefix_cl, colnames(seurat[[]]), value = TRUE) %>% sort()
kable_cluster(
  seurat,
  clusters, 
  file = file.path(path_fig, "clusters.png")
)
grep(prefix_cl, colnames(seurat2[[]]), value = TRUE) %>% sort() %>%
  kable_cluster(
    seurat,
    ., 
    file = file.path(path_fig, "clusters2.png")
)
```

```{r, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 10}
clustree_sc(seurat, prefix_cl, clusters)
```

```{r, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 8}
clustree_sc(seurat2, prefix_cl, clusters)
```

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
plot_res(seurat, clusters)
plot_res(
  seurat, 
  clusters[c(3, 5, 6, 8)],
  ncol = 2
  )
plot_res(
  seurat,
  clusters,
  cols = scales::hue_pal()
)
```
